about:
Automation Components Inc (ACI) has been manufacturing building automation sensors in Middleton, Wisconsin, since 1991. The company employs over 200 people across four facilities in Middleton, where it engineers, designs, and produces its sensor lines.

ACI’s product portfolio spans temperature, humidity, pressure, current, gas, interface, wireless, BACnet/Modbus, air quality, and power metering sensors. Temperature sensors are double encapsulated for durability; humidity sensors carry a five-year warranty and are field calibratable. The company builds thousands of custom sensors daily, offering variations in probe length, wire type, fittings, private branding, and packaging.

The sensors serve building automation, HVAC, data center, refrigeration, air handling, chiller, and indoor air quality applications. Customers include system integrators, contractors, and facility managers who need reliable monitoring for energy management, equipment performance, and occupant health.

ACI differentiates itself through ISO 9001:2015 certification, domestic manufacturing, and a service model that includes live technical support via phone, email, chat, or video conference, consistent fast shipping, and no minimum order requirements. The company states that its culture of empowered, long-term employees drives both product innovation and philanthropic initiatives.
